title: High-Stakes Veto: China and Russia Block UN Resolution on Strait of Hormuz Security
description: China and Russia vetoed a U.N. resolution urging coordinated efforts to secure the Strait of Hormuz, citing bias against Iran. The U.S. criticized this move, noting it upheld Iran's blockade impacting global commerce. The resolution, softened to avoid military force, aimed to ensure safe navigation in the vital waterway.

title: China Intensifies Coercive Strategy Against Taiwan, Targets Independence Supporters: Reports
description: China is escalating a "push and pull" strategy against Taiwan, using coercive measures and economic incentives to undermine sovereignty, including transnational repression tactics like bounties and wanted notices targeting independence supporters.

title: Taiwan opposition leader visits China for 'peace' talks amid rising tensions
description: Taiwan opposition leader Cheng Li-wun visited China for “peace” talks with Xi Jinping, as tensions rise, defense spending stalls, and Beijing ramps up military pressure on the self-ruled island.

title: Russia and China Veto Proposed U.N. Resolution to Open the Strait of Hormuz
